prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer
- For Pleasanton the reliable options people use most are Discount Tire, Firestone Complete Auto Care, and (if you’re a member) Costco Tire Center — plus a few independent shops in the Tri‑Valley that often give very personalized service. Which is “best” depends on whether you want lowest price, fastest install, or highest-quality balancing/alignments.

If you want a quick recommendation:
- Best overall value + service: Discount Tire (good inventory, free lifetime rotations at many locations, solid install work)
- Best price for members: Costco Tire Center (very competitive prices and good mounting/balancing when you’re a member)
- Best for full service (alignments, repairs, diagnostics): Firestone or a reputable independent shop
- Best personalized attention: a well‑rated independent Pleasanton/Tri‑Valley tire shop (look for recent Yelp/Google reviews)

How to pick the best place for installation
Ask or check for:
- ASE- or TIA-certified technicians
- Road‑force or dynamic balancing capability (recommended for high‑performance or uneven wear)
- TPMS programming/installation if your car uses sensors
- Proper torqueing and free re‑torque after 50–100 miles
- Alignment machine on site (if you’re replacing two tires or your car pulls/vibrates)
- Tire warranty registration and what’s included (mounting, valve stems, disposal)
- Price transparency (mount & balance, valve stems, tire disposal fees, balancing type)

What to expect and questions to ask when you call
- “Does your quoted price include mounting, standard wheel balancing, and valve stems?”
- “Do you offer road‑force balancing and what’s the extra cost?”
- “Can you program/replace TPMS sensors if needed?”
- “Do you re‑torque lug nuts after installation and will you check torque at 50–100 miles?”
- “Do you provide free lifetime rotations/balancing or a warranty on the install?”

Typical costs (ballpark)
- Mount & balance per tire: ~$15–40 (varies by shop and wheel size)
- Road‑force balancing: +$20–40 per tire (if needed)
- Alignment: ~$80–150 (if required)
Prices vary widely—call shops for up‑to‑date quotes.

Next step I can help with
If you want, tell me:
- Your ZIP code or nearest cross streets in Pleasanton
- Vehicle make/model/year and tire size (or current tires)
- Whether you have a Costco membership
- What’s most important: price, speed, or highest‑quality installation

I’ll then give 3–5 specific shops in Pleasanton/Tri‑Valley to call (with what to ask each).
